notes: Spokane renders parcels directly from GeoParquet in the browser (usePmtiles:false in spokane.json) — 81k parcels load fine client-side, so no PMTiles/H3 hex layer is used. Neighborhood region show/hide toggles (Land Value 3D + Parking). Spokane is a GeoParquet city (no bake) — the widgets compute region counts from the loaded features, so tagging the parquet (augment_spokane_regions.py) + this config is all that's needed (no metadata.groups). 29 City of Spokane neighborhoods.
